senses.gloss: f. (אלף, ילף; Assyr. êlippu) ship, raft.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jonah 1:3">Targ. Jon. I, 3</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 12:1">Lev. R. s. 12</cite>, beg. <he>כהדא א׳</he> like the ship tossed about on high sea.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 3:2">Koh. R. to III, 2</cite> (prov.) at the time thou tiest thy Lulab (for the Feast of Booths) <he>קטר אלפך</he> tie thy ship (cease navigation).
Ab. Zar. 10ᵇ ווי לה לאי׳ וכ׳ woe to the ship which leades without having paid its toll (of a convert who died before circumcision).—Trnsf. the body of a chicken (chest-bone resembling a ship).

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Lam. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>נסבית הדין אי׳ וכ׳</he> (<cite ref="T00152"><he>רבתי</he></cite>) I took for myself this ship (of the chicken), for in a ship I came &c.—Pl. <he>אִילְפַיָּא</he>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 104:26">Targ. Ps. CIV, 26</cite>; a. e.
